description: Use when testing NoSQL-backed applications (MongoDB, CouchDB, Redis) for injection on an authorized engagement. Covers detecting NoSQL backends, operator injection ($ne, $gt, $regex, $where) in JSON bodies and query strings, authentication bypass with $ne tricks, boolean blind extraction with $regex, JavaScript injection through $where, and automating extraction with Python 3.12. Use when login forms or search features talk to a document database, when JSON payloads accept query operators, or when classic SQL payloads fail but the backend is not relational.
